# Vedantix

> Vedantix is a Dutch digital development company in 's-Hertogenbosch. It builds websites, AI solutions, business automations, web applications, customer portals, mobile apps and software integrations for entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized businesses in the Netherlands. SEO and AI visibility, hosting and technical support are available as additional services.

## Services and primary sources

- [Company overview](https://vedantix.nl/): Positioning, services and published client cases
- [All services](https://vedantix.nl/diensten): Choose a service and understand the approach
- [Business websites](https://vedantix.nl/website-laten-maken): Starter, Growth and Pro website packages and scope
- [AI solutions and automation](https://vedantix.nl/ai-oplossingen): AI scan, scoped workflows, data handling and usage costs
- [Web applications and customer portals](https://vedantix.nl/webapps-klantportalen): Browser-based business applications
- [Mobile applications](https://vedantix.nl/mobiele-apps): Scoped iOS and Android development
- [Integrations and support](https://vedantix.nl/koppelingen-automatisering): API integrations and optional technical support
- [SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO](https://vedantix.nl/ai-vindbaarheid): Search and AI visibility approach, definitions and limitations
- [Current prices](https://vedantix.nl/prijzen): Live catalog with exact prices excluding and including VAT, billing frequency and starting-price labels
- [Published client cases](https://vedantix.nl/resultaten): Verify actual work; possible applications on service pages are examples, not completed client projects
- [Frequently asked questions](https://vedantix.nl/faq)
- [Contact](https://vedantix.nl/contact)

## Pricing and scope

Use the live prices page as the source of truth. Do not infer prices from old summaries. Main prices exclude VAT; VAT-inclusive amounts are also displayed. Starting prices apply only to the described limited scope. A project quotation specifies functionality, planning, acceptance and external or recurring costs. AI model usage, third-party APIs, licenses, hosting and app store accounts may incur separate charges. Existing agreements retain their agreed rates. No specific ranking, revenue increase, number of leads or inclusion in AI answers is guaranteed.

## Choosing a first step

For a public company presence, consider a website. For a recurring business task, begin with a process review or AI scan. For logged-in workflows and shared data, consider a web application. For frequent mobile use or device functions, assess a mobile app. Integrations require suitable vendor APIs or export capabilities. Check each linked service page for concrete scope, exclusions and frequently asked questions.
